title: 藏舟坞 Cangzhou Wu
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: 3 boxes stand in this compound, 3 on blocks drawn on the plan, 0 assumed. Its halls are listed below.

evidence.title: 圆明园遗址的遗产价值与申遗构想: the buildings left after 1860, citing 刘敦桢 1933
evidence.locator: ylfj, note 34: 刘敦桢, 同治重修圆明园史料, 营造学社汇刊 1933(2)
evidence.summary: Lists 17 buildings left after the burning of 1860, after 刘敦桢: 紫碧山房, 顺木天, 鱼跃鸢飞, 课农轩, 藏舟坞, 慎修思永, 知过堂, 双鹤斋, 蓬岛瑶台, 魁星楼, 文昌阁, 林渊锦镜, 春雨轩; 海岳开襟; 庄严法界, 正觉寺 and a 大宫门 in 万春园. The paper's aim is to hold any new display to this 1860 state.

evidence.title: 藏舟坞: hill and survival
evidence.locator: 三幅样式雷 section 四; 阙维民 citing 刘敦桢 1933
evidence.summary: Yangshi Lei river plans show earth heaped on the 藏舟坞 side south-east of 方壶胜境. 藏舟坞 is on the lists of what stood after 1860.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 四宜书屋
evidence.summary: First 春宇舒和; rebuilt in mid-Qianlong after the Chen family garden at Haining as 安澜园. A five-bay main hall, 葄经馆, 飞睇亭, 涵雅斋, 采芳洲, 无边风月之阁, 涵秋堂, 云涛亭, 烟月清真楼, 远秀山房, 绿帷舫, 染霞楼, 得趣书屋, 啸竹轩, 挹香室. The great boat dock 藏舟坞 adjoins.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 四宜书屋
evidence.summary: First 春宇舒和; rebuilt in mid-Qianlong after the Chen family garden at Haining as 安澜园. A five-bay main hall, 葄经馆, 飞睇亭, 涵雅斋, 采芳洲, 无边风月之阁, 涵秋堂, 云涛亭, 烟月清真楼, 远秀山房, 绿帷舫, 染霞楼, 得趣书屋, 啸竹轩, 挹香室. The great boat dock 藏舟坞 adjoins.

evidence.title: 三幅样式雷圆明园河道全图辨析: earth moved
evidence.summary: One listed change between plans: the hill at 澡身浴德 was removed and earth was added beside 藏舟坞, south-east of 方壶胜境, and east of 三潭印月, spoil from dredging being the usual source. Useful for the hills layer on the east shore.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
